title: Recipes & production
intro: Define batch recipes, run production to consume inputs and create outputs, and review production history.

sections.title: Recipes list
steps: Browse active recipes with batch size and output items.
Add or edit recipes that drive kitchen prep and costing.
sections.caption: Recipes maintenance tab.

sections.title: Recipe form
sections.intro: A recipe defines input items, output yields, and how cost is allocated across outputs.
steps: Click Add recipe or edit an existing row.
Enter name, code, and base batch quantity.
Add input lines with item and quantity.
Add output lines with yield percent, disposition, and primary flag.
Save to use the recipe in production batches.
sections.caption: Recipe form with inputs and outputs.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Display name shown in production and reports.

fields.name: Code
fields.effect: Optional short code for kitchen reference.

fields.name: Base batch qty
fields.effect: Standard batch size used to scale ingredient quantities.

fields.name: Cost allocation
fields.effect: Method for spreading input cost across multiple outputs.

fields.name: Input items
fields.effect: Inventory items and quantities consumed per batch.

fields.name: Output items
fields.effect: Items produced, with yield % and which output is primary.

fields.name: Is active
fields.effect: Inactive recipes are hidden from new production runs.

sections.title: Production runs
steps: Start a new batch from an active recipe.
Preview scaled ingredients, then complete to post inventory movements.
sections.caption: Production tab with batch list.

sections.title: Production batch form
sections.intro: Completing a batch deducts inputs and adds outputs at the chosen location.
steps: Select recipe, location, and produced quantity.
Review the preview of scaled inputs and outputs.
Optionally update item cost from the batch.
Complete to post the batch and write production history.
sections.caption: Production batch form with preview.

fields.name: Recipe
fields.effect: Determines ingredients and outputs for the batch.

fields.name: Location
fields.effect: Store where stock is consumed and produced.

fields.name: Produced qty
fields.effect: Scales the recipe from base batch size to this quantity.

fields.name: Batch number
fields.effect: Optional reference printed on labels or history.

fields.name: Update item cost
fields.effect: When checked, recalculates output item cost from batch totals.

fields.name: Notes
fields.effect: Free-text note stored on the production record.

sections.title: Production history
steps: Open Production history to audit completed batches.
Filter by date, recipe, or location.
Open a row to view inputs, outputs, and who posted the batch.
sections.caption: Production history list.
